theorem_title: A coarse one-third bound on the mechanical remainder
natural_language_statement:
For $s\in\mathbb N$, define $M(0)=0$, $M(s+1)=3M(s)+2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor}$, and $e(s)=\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor+1$.

For every $s\in\mathbb N$,

$$
3M(s)\le s3^s.
$$

This universal numerical envelope supports a conditional first-contraction gap estimate.
